description: This file contains unit tests for the IniFileReader class, verifying token splitting, handling of quoted tokens, parsing of configuration lines, and reading metadata from an INI file.

classes.name: IniFileReaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionalities of IniFileReader.

methods.name: testSplit
methods.description: Tests the splitTokens method for various input cases.

methods.name: testQuotedTokens
methods.description: Tests token splitting with quoted strings.

methods.name: testRealLine
methods.description: Tests parsing of a typical INI line with key-value pairs.

methods.name: testTotalPagesSize
methods.description: Tests reading and parsing of INI file metadata, including number of pages, signature, page read commands, and total size.
